definitions.explanation: The sensation or quality perceived when touching something with the hands. Used to describe how materials, fabrics, surfaces, and objects feel to the touch.

examples.english: This cloth has a nice feel.

examples.japanese: カシミヤ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手触|てざわ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The feel of cashmere is exceptional.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手触|てざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|なめ}らか→滑らか：06068_nameraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using this shampoo makes your hair feel smooth to the touch.

notes:
{手触|てざわ}り describes the tactile quality of something — how it feels when touched by hand. It is commonly used when evaluating fabrics, materials, cosmetics, and food textures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手触|てざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: good texture, pleasant feel
- {手触|てざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: bad texture, unpleasant feel
- ⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧{手触|てざわ}り: soft feel
- ⟦{滑|なめ}らか→滑らか：06068_nameraka⟧な{手触|てざわ}り: smooth feel
- {手触|てざわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧: to check the feel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧: feel against the skin (for clothing, bedding)
- ⟦{感触|かんしょく}→感触：12743_kanshoku⟧: feel, touch (broader, also used figuratively)
- {触|さわ}り{心地|ごこち}: tactile comfort
